result.instructions: Excel MCP Server for manipulating Excel files

tools.name: apply_formula
tools.description:
Apply Excel formula to cell.
    Excel formula will write to cell with verification.

tools.name: validate_formula_syntax
tools.description: Validate Excel formula syntax without applying it.

tools.name: format_range
tools.description: Apply formatting to a range of cells.

tools.name: read_data_from_excel
tools.description:
Read data from Excel worksheet with cell metadata including validation rules.
    
    Args:
        filepath: Path to Excel file
        sheet_name: Name of worksheet
        start_cell: Starting cell (default A1)
        end_cell: Ending cell (optional, auto-expands if not provided)
        preview_only: Whether to return preview only
    
    Returns:  
    JSON string containing structured cell data with validation metadata.
    Each cell includes: address, value, row, column, and validation info (if any).

tools.name: write_data_to_excel
tools.description:
Write data to Excel worksheet.
    Excel formula will write to cell without any verification.

    PARAMETERS:  
    filepath: Path to Excel file
    sheet_name: Name of worksheet to write to
    data: List of lists containing data to write to the worksheet, sublists are assumed to be rows
    start_cell: Cell to start writing to, default is "A1"

tools.name: create_workbook
tools.description: Create new Excel workbook.

tools.name: create_worksheet
tools.description: Create new worksheet in workbook.

tools.name: create_chart
tools.description: Create chart in worksheet.

tools.name: create_pivot_table
tools.description: Create pivot table in worksheet.

tools.name: create_table
tools.description: Creates a native Excel table from a specified range of data.

tools.name: copy_worksheet
tools.description: Copy worksheet within workbook.

tools.name: delete_worksheet
tools.description: Delete worksheet from workbook.

tools.name: rename_worksheet
tools.description: Rename worksheet in workbook.

tools.name: get_workbook_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata about workbook including sheets, ranges, etc.

tools.name: merge_cells
tools.description: Merge a range of cells.

tools.name: unmerge_cells
tools.description: Unmerge a range of cells.

tools.name: get_merged_cells
tools.description: Get merged cells in a worksheet.

tools.name: copy_range
tools.description: Copy a range of cells to another location.

tools.name: delete_range
tools.description: Delete a range of cells and shift remaining cells.

tools.name: validate_excel_range
tools.description: Validate if a range exists and is properly formatted.

tools.name: get_data_validation_info
tools.description:
Get all data validation rules in a worksheet.
    
    This tool helps identify which cell ranges have validation rules
    and what types of validation are applied.
    
    Args:
        filepath: Path to Excel file
        sheet_name: Name of worksheet
        
    Returns:
        JSON string containing all validation rules in the worksheet

tools.name: insert_rows
tools.description: Insert one or more rows starting at the specified row.

tools.name: insert_columns
tools.description: Insert one or more columns starting at the specified column.

tools.name: delete_sheet_rows
tools.description: Delete one or more rows starting at the specified row.

tools.name: delete_sheet_columns
tools.description: Delete one or more columns starting at the specified column.
